text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since going to watch the Japanese Derby as a kid, Vodka has dreamed passionately of racing there one day and becoming the coolest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, to both gain the recognition of her role model, Narita Brian, and to show up her closest rival, Daiwa Scarlet…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka stands at the starting line of the Twinkle Series, engine revving majestically.
